summary.batchCompleted: Batch 1 — shared design system + global card/modal elevation

issues.title: Cloned Bolt reference broke the app type-check/build
issues.detail: Cloning the Bolt repo into design-reference/bolt-ui put react-router-dom .tsx files under the app tsconfig include glob (**/*.tsx). `npm run build` then failed type-check with 'Cannot find module react-router-dom'.
issues.fix: Added 'design-reference' to tsconfig.json exclude, and added /design-reference/ to .gitignore so the reference clone is never type-checked, built, or committed.

observations.detail: e2e/20-core-stability-6.spec.ts Part 1 (UserMenu hover + 1600ms flash-ring) failed once under full parallel run (111/112) but passed 8/8 in isolation. Timing race, not a regression from this pass (no logic/selector changed).

App was already Phase-9 polished and shares the Bolt warm-orange/cream palette. Batch 1 adopted Bolt's softer layered shadow tokens + new shared primitives (PageShell/SectionHeader/StatCard/MetricGrid). Per-page worker/employer/admin composition refreshes (Batches 2-5) are planned and gated on review to avoid one giant risky edit on heavily-tested pages.
